Nearest City: Brielle, NJ

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER REPORTS A VESSEL EXPLODED AT HOFFMAN'S MARINA FUELING DOCK ON THE MANASQUAN RIVER. THE PLEASURE CRAFT WAS FUELING AT THE DOCK AND FUEL TANK WAS FULL WHEN THE MOTORS WERE DISCOVERED NOT OPERATING CORRECTLY AS THE VESSEL WAS ABOUT TO LEAVE THE DOCK. THE OPERATOR TRIED STARTING UP THE MOTORS BY TOUCHING 2 WIRES TOGETHER WHEN THE VESSEL EXPLODED. GASOLINE DISCHARGED INTO THE WATER ABOUT 100 YARDS OFF THE FUELING DOCK, AND TWO MEN ABOARD THE VESSEL SUFFERED BURNS TO 20% OF THEIR BODIES AND WERE TAKEN TO THE HOSPITAL.

properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 716154 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: USCG - MSO BUFFALO
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 716154
Incident Time: 2004-03-16 07:30:00
Nearest City: Youngstown, NY
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: OIL, FUEL: NO. 2-D
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: USCG - MSO BUFFALO
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 12 gallons
CALLER STATED THAT A TOW TRUCK WAS TOWING A MINIVAN DOWN THE ROAD. THE DRIVER OF THE TOW TRUCK LOOKED DOWN TO GET A CIGARETTE, AND WHEN HE LOOKED UP, HE WAS OFF THE ROAD, DRIVING DOWN AND EMBANKMENT, AND INTO THE RIVER. THE MINIVAN SLAMMED INTO THE BACK OF THE TOW TRUCK. THE INCIDENT RESULTED IN A RELEASE OF APPROXIMATELY 12 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL INTO THE RIVER. THE DRIVER AND THE PASSENGER OF THE TOW TRUCK WERE SENT TO THE HOSPITAL, BUT WERE SUBSEQUENTLY RELEASED WITHOUT INJURIES. THE TOW TRUCK AND THE MINIVAN WERE TOWED OUT BY A THIRD PARTY TOW TRUCK CONTRACTOR. TOW TRUCK TOWING MINIVAN, DRIVING DOWN STREET, OPERATOR ERROR, DROVE DOWN INTO RIVER
